August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 265)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on August 28 across American network radio and syndication, the Army Air Forces dance orchestra playing for factory defense workers on Spotlight Bands, three classic Western adventures starring Roy Rogers & Dale Evans (1949 Quaker Oats cattle stampede, 1952 Post Cereals sweepstakes race, and Trigger busting counterfeiters), Olan Soule in Grand Marquee, and Jim French's crime-scene cleanup sleuth Clean Sweep (1945–1999):
